name: milesight_iot_ws52x
description: Milesight WS52x is a LoRaWAN® smart portable socket that monitors and controls electrical appliances. It supports international socket types, enables local/remote on/off control, measures power consumption, and sends overcurrent alarms.
author: Thinger.io
